Your ONLY change is removing the gray checkerboard outside the blue/gold frame silhouette and edge bubbles, replacing it with ACTUAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA pixels in an RGBA PNG. Make this a transparent PNG asset. Delete the entire gray checkered background around the outside of the UI frame, with clean anti-aliased edges and real alpha transparency. validation.textRemoved: All editable labels removed; XP remains on the star.
validation.stageRings: Exactly five matching neutral hollow blue rings.
validation.layout: Preserves the source relative panel, title, icon, progress-track, stage-ring, pointer geometry.
validation.transparency: True alpha outside the frame; no baked checkerboard. Alpha above 32 forms exactly one connected component. Far stray edge specks have alpha no greater than 8 and are visually negligible when composited.
validation.visibleDeviations: Generated interior is slightly brighter and smoother than the reference. Border bubbles and seaweed are close recreations rather than identical pixels. Tiny low-alpha edge artifacts remain outside the border; artwork is saved unchanged.
validation.rejectedAlternatives: First two outputs were RGB with checkerboard. A later edge-cleanup output returned RGB and removed seaweed; a fresh text-only output moved the icons. The third extraction is the closest accepted version.
